snippet.title: Wirelight - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A tiny turn-based tactical... soulslike!

Explore a twisty, interconnected world, battle enemies using a unique spin on a ‘posture’ system, and employ various upgrades to your advantage.

Releasing on PC (Windows and Linux) in Q3 2025

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3512420/Wirelight/
Follow in Itch: https://e1sif.itch.io/wirelight (add to a collection to get updates!)

Full presskit available here: https://e1sif.com/presskits/wirelight.html

This game is developed by elsif, using the Godot engine.
Bsky: https://bsky.app/profile/e1sif.itch.io
Mastodon: https://mastodon.gamedev.place/@elsif
